refund_curve.method: Refunds matched to their order's acquisition week; 21 cohorts aged >=16w from 2026-01-01 onward.

config._comment: Editable cost inputs and parameters. In Phase 3 this is the file the Action reads (mirrored from the shared Sheet). Every cost line carries a provenance kind: 'ad' = measured from Triple Whale, plan figure here is budget only; 'retainer' = monthly, accrued into weeks; 'variable' = lumpy, set per week.

accrual.note: monthly x 12/52. Reproduces Clayton's reported $276 for wk of Aug 3. Alternatives: calendar_days (7/30.44), divide_4 (/4.0).

historical_cac_constants._comment: DECISION 2026-08-18: sheet denominators frozen as historical constants; Shopify used going forward. Discontinuity is intentional and must be labeled.

notes_to_resolve: Superfiliate ($599/mo), Impact platform fee ($20/mo) and social media platform ($200/mo) appear in the 2026 Budget sheet but not in the current spend table. $819/mo unaccounted.
No TikTok spend as of 2026-08-18 (confirmed by Caitlin). Toast-TikTok retainer folded into the single $10,000 Toast line.
config._cost_table_effective_from_note: The date this cost table took effect. NEEDS CONFIRMATION from Caitlin. Cost lines change over time — the earlier budget-sheet structure totalled $67,069/mo of retainers with Toast split across four lines, versus $54,750 now. Weeks before this date are computed on a cost basis that was not actually in force, so their CAC is approximate and the dashboard says so. Per-line effective_from/effective_to is the proper fix; the schema honours those fields if present.
